source.title: Niru - Soul Collector
source.name: Niru
source.description: A Support who is well-versed in enchantments that can ensure allies remain helpful in the field in spirit form.

skills.name: Soul Shepherd

description.raw: Niru prioritizes the weakest ally and cast a spell to protect them for a fatal blow, turning them into a Spirit and restoring their HP to 45% of max HP. The Spirit can only deal 45% + 5% (SP-based) of its original damage while losing an increasing amount of HP every second. Once its HP runs out, the Spirit will be defeated.
active: Niru prioritizes the weakest ally and cast a spell to protect them for a fatal blow, turning them into a Spirit and restoring their HP to 45% of max HP.
The Spirit can only deal 45% + 5% (SP-based) of its original damage while losing an increasing amount of HP every second.
Once its HP runs out, the Spirit will be defeated.

text: Unlocks at level 51: For every (up to 5) non-summoned enemy defeated, the blessed ally restores an extra 10% of max HP when entering the Spirit form.
Unlocks at level 111: For every non-summoned enemy defeated, they ally in Spirit form restores 10% of max HP (up to 5 times for each character).
Unlocks at level 171: Ally in Spirit form deals 55% + 5% (SP-based)} of the original damage.
Unlocks at level 231: Ally in Spirit form deals 65% + 5% (SP-based)} of the original damage.

skills.description_lite: Niru stores 1 ally's soul, allowing them to continue fighting on the battlefield in Spirit form after taking a fatal blow.

skills.name: Soul Reaping

description.raw: Niru attacks the weakest enemy, dealing 120% (ATK-based) + 20% (SP-based) damage plus damage equal to 0.3 times the target's lost HP. The additional damage cannot exceed 450% (ATK-based).
active: Niru attacks the weakest enemy, dealing 120% (ATK-based) + 20% (SP-based) damage plus damage equal to 0.3 times the target's lost HP.
The additional damage cannot exceed 450% (ATK-based).

text: Increases additional damage to 0.35 times of the target's lost HP, up to 525% (ATK-based).
Increases additional damage to 0.4 times of the target's lost HP, up to 600% (ATK-based).
Increases additional damage to 0.45 times of the target's lost HP, up to 600% (ATK-based).

skills.description_lite: Niru deals damage to the weakest enemy. The lower the target's HP, the higher the damage.

skills.name: Spirit Devour

description.raw: Niru drains the life force of all enemies, dealin 150% (ATK-based) + 15% (SP-based) damage to each enemy, plus 3% of the target's max HP, up to 70% (ATK-based). He then restores an equal amount of HP to the weakest ally.
active: Niru drains the life force of all enemies, dealin 150% (ATK-based) + 15% (SP-based) damage to each enemy, plus 3% of the target's max HP, up to 70% (ATK-based).
He then restores an equal amount of HP to the weakest ally.

text: The damage dealt to each enemy is increased to 160% (ATK-based) + 15% (SP-based), plus 3,5% of the target's max HP, up to 80% (ATK-based).
The damage dealt to each enemy is increased to 170% (ATK-based) + 15% (SP-based), plus 3% of the target's max HP, up to 90% (ATK-based).
The damage dealt to each enemy is increased to 180% (ATK-based) + 15% (SP-based), plus 5% of the target's max HP, up to 100% (ATK-based).

skills.description_lite: Niru drains the life force of all enemies to heal the weakest ally.

active: Increases HP by 17% during battle.

text: Increases HP by 23% during battle.
Increases HP by 29% during battle.

skills.name: Ethereal Form

description.raw: Niru casts Ultimate on the nearest ally without consuming Energy when a battle starts, prioritizing the ally behind himself.
active: Niru casts Ultimate on the nearest ally without consuming Energy when a battle starts, prioritizing the ally behind himself.

text: The spirit will not lose HP over time until all allies enter Spirit form for 8s.
